Bir şirkette 5 yıldır görev yapan kimya mühendisinin iş sözleşmesi, başka bir firmaya yardımcı olduğu iddiasıyla feshedildi.
İşten çıkarılmasının haksız olduğunu savunan mühendis, ücret artışlarından doğan farkların kendisine ödenmediğini belirterek İş Mahkemesi'ne başvurdu.
Davacı, ödenmeyen ücret alacaklarının tahsil edilmesini talep ederken işveren ise çalışanın sadakat yükümlülüğüne aykırı davrandığını ileri sürdü.
Dava dosyasına yansıyan bilgilere göre kimya mühendisi, işveren şirketin anlaşmalı olduğu otelde, başka bir firmanın yetkilisi adına yöneticilere haber vermeden ve izin almadan rezervasyon yaptırdı.
Ayrıca davacının, işverenle aynı sektörde faaliyet gösteren başka bir şirketin yetkilisi için toplantılar organize ettiği belirlendi.
Mühendisin izinli olduğu dönemde, çalıştığı şirkete ait araçla söz konusu firma yetkilisini şehir içindeki ve şehir dışındaki toplantılara götürdüğü de dosyadaki delillerle ortaya konuldu.
İlk derece mahkemesi, mühendisin bu davranışlardan maddi bir menfaat elde ettiğinin kanıtlanamadığına dikkat çekerek iş sözleşmesinin haklı nedenle feshedilmesini ölçüsüz buldu.
Bununla birlikte geçerli fesih nedeninin bulunduğuna hükmeden mahkeme, davayı kısmen kabul etti.
Sabah'ta yer alan habere göre, işverenin istinaf başvurusu da Bölge Adliye Mahkemesi tarafından reddedildi.
İşverenin temyiz başvurusu üzerine dosyayı inceleyen Yargıtay 9. Hukuk Dairesi ise farklı bir değerlendirmede bulundu.
Yüksek Mahkeme, mühendisin davranışlarının doğruluk ve bağlılık ilkeleriyle bağdaşmadığını belirterek işverenin güvenini zedeleyen eylemlerin haklı fesih nedeni oluşturduğuna karar verdi.
Kararda, işçinin bu davranışları nedeniyle mutlaka maddi bir çıkar sağlamış olmasının gerekmediği de vurgulandı.
Yargıtay 9. Hukuk Dairesi, işverenin iş sözleşmesini haklı nedenle feshettiği sonucuna ulaştı.
Bu nedenle davacı lehine kıdem ve ihbar tazminatına hükmedilmesini hukuka aykırı bulan Yüksek Mahkeme, yerel mahkemenin kararını bozdu.

Hamile sevgilisi Sharon Kovacs'ın hastaneye kaldırıldığını duyurarak sevenlerinden dua isteyen Ufuk Beydemir'den yeni paylaşım geldi. 25'inci gebelik haftasına girdiklerini belirten şarkıcı, sürecin 'çok yıpratıcı' olduğunu söyledi.
34 yaşındaki şarkıcı Ufuk Beydemir, Ay Tenli Kadın, Sevda Gibi ve Hiç gibi şarkılarıyla tanınıyor. Beydemir, bugünlerde özel hayatıyla da gündemde: Hollandalı şarkıcı Sharon Kovacs ile birlikte bebeklerini bekliyor. Baba olacağı haberi ilk olarak Ağustos ayında gündeme gelmişti.
Ufuk Beydemir, 2022 yılında oyuncu İpek Filiz Yazıcı ile Roma'da nikâh masasına oturmuştu. Evlilikleri uzun sürmedi ve ikili 2025 yılında yollarını ayırdı. Ayrılığın nedenine dair bir açıklama yapılmadı.
Beydemir, bir süre önce yaptığı paylaşımda bebeklerinin beklenenden çok erken dünyaya gelmek üzere olduğunu duyurmuş ve hastaneye yetişmek için Hollanda'ya uçtuğunu söylemişti. Planladığı konseri de bu nedenle ertelemek zorunda kalmıştı. 'Sizleri seviyorum, dualarınızı bekliyorum' diyen şarkıcı, sevenlerinden dua istemişti.
Hastane odasından yaptığı sonraki paylaşımda 'Şimdilik her şey yolunda. Sharon da bebeğimiz de gayet iyi' diyen Beydemir, doktorların doğumu olabildiğince ertelemeye çalıştığını, bir süre hastanede kalacaklarını ama gidişatın iyi olduğunu anlattı. Gelen dua ve mesajların hepsini okuduğunu belirten şarkıcı, dualarını eksik etmemelerini istedi.
Son paylaşımında ise sarıldıkları bir fotoğrafla '25'inci haftaya girdik çok şükür. 1 haftadır hastanedeyiz ve doğuma kadar buradayız' dedi. Her geçen günün lehlerine olduğunu söyleyen Beydemir, sürecin yine de 'gerçekten çok yıpratıcı' olduğunu ekledi. Şarkıcı, bir süre önce havalimanından yaptığı paylaşımda da 'Kızımı görmeye gidiyorum' demişti.

Bazen bir öğretmenin tek bir cümlesi, bir ömrün yönünü değiştirmeye yeter. Kimi zaman bir cesaret sözü, kimi zaman insanı kamçılayan bir eleştiri... Nobel ödüllü bilim insanlarından dünyaca ünlü sunuculara kadar pek çok kişi, bugün bulundukları yeri sınıfta duydukları o cümleye borçlu olduklarını anlattı.
Nobel Kimya Ödülü sahibi Aziz Sancar'ın hikayesi Mardin 'in Savur ilçesinde başladı. TÜBİTAK Bilim ve Teknik dergisinin aktardığına göre sınıf öğretmeni küçük Aziz'deki ışığı fark etti ve bir gün ağabeyini okula çağırdı.
Öğretmenin ağabeyine söylediği söz şöyleydi: 'Bu çocuk özel, siz bunun üzerinde durun, bir yerlere varacak.' Yıllar sonra bu çocuk, Nobel Kimya Ödülü'nü aldı.
Stephen Hawking, İngiltere 'de St Albans School'da okurken matematik öğretmeni Dikran Tahta'nın sayesinde matematiğe ilgi duymaya başladı. Hawking'e göre Tahta, ona enerjisini doğru yere yönlendirmeyi ve matematik üzerine yaratıcı düşünmeyi öğretti.
Hawking, 2016'da Tes'in yayımladığı bir video mesajında öğretmenine teşekkür ederken şu cümleyi kurdu: 'Her olağanüstü insanın arkasında olağanüstü bir öğretmen vardır.'
Oprah Winfrey'in hayatında iki öğretmenin izi var. Biri, Nashville'deki 4. sınıf öğretmeni Bayan Duncan. Oprah, onun sayesinde dünyayla baş edebileceğine inandığını ve bugün bir talk show 'u olmasının sebebinin bu olduğunu söylemişti.
Diğeri ise sınıfına hiç girmediği Gene Abrams. Abrams, Oprah'ın Milwaukee'nin en iyi okullarından birine kabul edilen siyah öğrenciler arasına girmesini sağladı. Yıllar sonra programda yeniden karşılaştıklarında ona şöyle dedi: 'Karşılaştığım en meraklı 13 yaşındaki çocuktun. Elinde hep bir kitap , aklında hep bir soru vardı.'
Her cümle cesaret vermez, bazıları insanı kamçılar. Sivaslı emekli demiryolu çalışanı Arif Sayyar, ilkokul 5. sınıftaki resim öğretmeninin çizdiği resme bakıp kendisine yeteneksiz dediğini, onu sınıfın en yeteneksiz çocuğu ilan ettiğini anlattı .
Sayyar'ın ifadesiyle bu söz onu kamçıladı ve sürekli resim yapmaya başladı. Demiryollarında geçen 33 yılın ardından trenleri ve Anadolu'nun köy yaşamını tuvale aktaran bir ressam oldu.
Cezayir'de yoksul bir ailede büyüyen Albert Camus'nün okuma hayatını ilkokul öğretmeni Louis Germain değiştirdi. Germain, onun bursla liseye girmesine yardım etti.
1957'de Nobel Edebiyat Ödülü'nü kazandığında Camus'nün aklına ilk gelen o oldu. 19 Kasım 1957'de öğretmenine yazdığı mektupta , yoksul bir çocuğa uzattığı o sevgi dolu el ve verdiği örnek olmasaydı bunların hiçbirinin gerçekleşmeyeceğini söyledi. Nobel konuşmasını da öğretmenine ithaf etti.
Hepimizin aklında, bir öğretmenimizden duyduğumuz ve yıllar geçse de unutamadığımız bir cümle vardır. Kimimizi cesaretlendirdi, kimimizi hırslandırdı.
Sizin hayatınıza dokunan o cümle neydi? Yorumlarda paylaşın, Öğretmenler Günü'nde öğretmenlerinizi birlikte analım.

Kevin de Bruyne won six Premier League titles, the Champions League, two FA Cups and five League Cups during his time at Manchester City
Kevin de Bruyne says his feelings for Manchester City will "never change" even if the club are stripped of their titles after being found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial rules.
De Bruyne, 35, enjoyed a trophy-laden decade at Etihad Stadium, lifting 16 trophies including the Treble in 2023 before leaving on a free transfer to join Napoli in 2025.
The Belgian returns to City for the second time on Tuesday when Napoli play them in the Champions League.
De Bruyne says he has "nothing but affection" for the club and that "will never change" even if City were forced to give up their domestic titles.
"Of course, it's a lot of things that's been going on but I cannot change anything about that. I am proud of what I have done as a football player and, honestly, this is my club," he said.
"I love the owners, I have talked about a lot of stuff outside football - I have even spoken to [chairman] Khaldoon [Al Mubarak] about how to buy a club."
In September it was revealed that an independent commission found that City had arranged "sham contracts" with a number of commercial partners as part of a scheme to disguise secret funding of more than £830m.
City await any sanctions that may be imposed following their guilty verdict, with possible punishments ranging from a hefty fine, points deductions, relegation from the Premier League and being stripped of titles.
Asserting its innocence, City said it had filed "a comprehensive body of irrefutable evidence [that] exists in support of all of its positions" on 2 October.
Sources have told BBC Sport that City were expected to claim that key sponsorship deals were funded by the Abu Dhabi government, rather than the club's owners, as part of an appeal.
Criticism of City has been intense, but De Bruyne said he can't "change anything" about people calling his former club a "disgrace".
"Of course, in life there are rules, but everybody plays on the limit, I would say, and for me, I played in between the white lines," he said.
"I don't think a lot of people will change in their mind how they view me as a player, or how we played, but everybody has their own opinion."
De Bruyne will be afforded a generous ovation when he returns to Etihad Stadium, having played more than 400 games for City, scoring 108 goals.
After his final home game for the club in May 2025, it was announced that a statue will be built in his honour outside the stadium.

Kevin de Bruyne won 16 trophies in 10 years at Manchester City
Kevin de Bruyne's move to Napoli in 2025 was supposed to mark a continuation of his glittering decade at Manchester City as he approaches the twilight years of his career.
Instead, the midfielder, who is widely regarded as one of the stand-out players of his generation, has seen his time in Naples threaten to turn sour amid an early injury, friction with his team-mates and rumours of a January exit.
Napoli were Serie A champions in 2024-25 - the year before De Bruyne's arrival - but are currently languishing in eighth, while they sit 27th in the Champions League after a heavy 4-1 defeat at Porto earlier this month.
Belgium international De Bruyne lifted 16 trophies in his 10 years at City and is guaranteed a generous ovation when he returns to the Etihad Stadium on Tuesday but the highs of his time in England are in contrast to the struggles he is seemingly enduring in Italy.
"Not a lot I can say for the moment," said De Bruyne when asked about his future. "I have played at 100% until now and obviously I am not 20 years old, I am turning 36.
"There is a lot of things going in my mind but there is not a lot to say. I am playing good football, trying to help the team to do well and it has been a bit of a challenging season with a lot of things happening."
Statue, Pep's tears & a missed sitter - De Bruyne's emotional farewell
City decided not to renew De Bruyne's contract during the 2024-25 season and the player had the choice of heading to the US with Chicago Fire or staying in one of the top-five leagues in Europe.
The 35-year-old felt he could still cut it at the highest level but his first season at Napoli was heavily disrupted by a hamstring injury which kept him out for more than four months, restricting him to 21 appearances.
Napoli finished runners up to Inter Milan to lose their Serie A title and De Bruyne reportedly said , external he was "happy" manager Antonio Conte had departed in the summer as promises were not kept regarding the style of play.
But despite making his name as a technically gifted number 10, De Bruyne's role has been remodelled into a deeper holding one under Massimiliano Allegri in an ageing squad that has struggled this season.
In Porto, the fractures were clear to see, with De Bruyne having a heated on-field confrontation , external with striker Lorenzo Lucca and his team-mates were forced to step in to diffuse the situation.
The passionate side of De Bruyne's game was shown in Manchester too.
The midfielder shouted "shut up" at manager Pep Guardiola during a Champions League game against Real Madrid in 2023, and said "let me talk" when David Silva and Fernandinho were ushering him off the pitch at half-time shortly after he was booked against Napoli in 2017.
"Speaking about the pitch, De Bruyne is the best player this year at Napoli," Naples-based journalist Vincenzo Credendino tells BBC Sport. "The point is that the whole team is having difficulties.
"We saw that there is a problem, at least between De Bruyne and Lorenzo Lucca. Their acting was very, very clear and I think that in that time, the two of them were wrong.
"On one hand you cannot swear at another team-mate but on the other hand, De Bruyne reproached Lucca without encouraging him, so it was a bad show."
De Bruyne has played 16 times for Napoli this season - contributing four goals and two assists - but his long-term future at the club remains unclear.
In September, De Bruyne's wife reportedly , external told a Belgian publication about their desire to move back home, saying "the sooner we get there, the better" as the player leads a "very restricted life" in Naples.
Asked if the quotes had been misinterpreted, De Bruyne said: "To be honest, I am pretty annoyed because if you read the article, that none of you have read, to understand what she said.
"I was away in Belgium and a lot of noise came and a lot of bad reactions to my wife and family. I saw pictures of my house, I don't think it is OK but it is what it is and some press created this in Italy. I don't know why.
"Nobody knows my life, you will never know. People who work with me are not allowed to say anything but obviously it is something that I take away and think about. It has not been nice for my wife or for my family."
It has led to interest from the Netherlands with PSV Eindhoven making a £1.67m offer to sign him in January, but the two clubs are apart in their valuations as Napoli want up to £6.7m, according to Credendino.
"Napoli fans were not happy [with the interview]," he says. "There are many fans that say, 'OK, you can leave if you want, we are not putting chains on anybody'."
Napoli boss Allegri left the door open for a January exit by saying in his pre-match news conference the pair had "not spoken" about his future and it is "down to the players and who wants to leave" when the transfer window opens.
City manager Enzo Maresca was assistant to Pep Guardiola during the 2022-23 campaign in which De Bruyne helped the club to a Treble of trophies and the Italian has fond memories of the "fantastic season" they spent together.
"No doubt, [he is] one of the best," Maresca said of De Bruyne in his pre-match news conference. "Not only personally but also for the history of this club. In the last 10 years all the trophies the club achieved Kevin was here.
"He was an important player, a top guy, polite and for me it was a pleasure to work with him."
This is not the first time De Bruyne will be facing his former club with a reunion with City in the Champions League last season.
That trip turned out to be a bitterly unhappy experience, with De Bruyne substituted after 26 minutes following Giovanni di Lorenzo's red card in the 2-0 defeat.
The midfielder will be hoping for a better result on Tuesday as he aims to park his struggles for one evening.
City and Belgium winger Jeremy Doku said: "Kevin is someone that likes football. Even at this age he loves it.
"I don't have any doubts about his quality and I am sure everything will be fine in Napoli."

Even without the charges, the Belgian maestro will be an unwelcome throwback to happier times for Enzo Maresca
A s Manchester City come to terms with turbulence, one of their all-time greats has flown in to remind them of the best of times. Kevin De Bruyne will be back at the Etihad Stadium on Tuesday, evoking the greatest period of Pep Guardiola’s decade in charge when they won four straight Premier League titles and the Champions League .
In Europe, things are comfortable for Enzo Maresca, with three wins from four, but they have collected a solitary point from 12 domestically recently. They are struggling to score and conceding too easily at the back, leading the Italian to experiment in his attempts to find solutions.
De Bruyne left for nothing in the summer of 2025 , but had fully returned the £55m City paid for him 10 years previously. Six Premier League titles, two FA Cups, five League Cups, a Club World Cup and that night in Istanbul when City conquered Inter, successes he will for ever cherish. Admittedly, the Belgian departed early that night in Turkey through injury, something he battled with in his later years in England.
Maresca was Guardiola’s assistant for the 2023 treble season, working closely with De Bruyne. “In the last 10 years, all the trophies the club achieved, Kevin was here and an important player, a fantastic player, a top guy, polite, fantastic,” he said. “It was a pleasure to work with him.”
His return may be made slightly more appealing because his powers have waned in Serie A and his teammates are not faring any better , although his compatriot Jérémy Doku said: “It’s fun to play with him. The quality he has is unbelievable, but we are all competitive so we all have to be on our best.”
At his peak, De Bruyne was the driving force for Guardiola, a two‑footed mercurial talent who could change a game in an instant. He was someone clearly more talented than most of the elite, able to glide past opponents, find a pass no one else could or just shift the ball from one foot to the other and smash in a goal from distance.
“I play more based on the feeling I have and where the space is, where I can feel I’m the most dangerous,” De Bruyne said on Monday. A reminder City do not possess someone of the same mould; even if Rayan Cherki may think he can be the heir, he is yet to consistently prove it.
“You always have to have courage to play football, you cannot only go long and just play for duels,” De Bruyne says of a style that evolved under Guardiola.
City have enjoyed these glorious talents for years; Yaya Touré could control a midfield, David Silva was able to control entire games. Maresca does not have access to someone like that and instead is attempting to create a unified team that makes the most of its expensive parts, but is yet to strike the perfect balance. For all of Erling Haaland’s incredible qualities as a striker, he cannot do it all by himself; he is reliant on service, something he is not getting from midfield or out wide.
Maresca tried the teenager Ayyoub Bouaddi alongside Elliot Anderson against Fulham on Saturday , leaving out the £125m summer signing Enzo Fernández .
Anderson was given a more attacking role, provided the sort of thrust De Bruyne often did. He does not possess the same technical expertise as the Belgian, although his volley may have earned a round of applause from his predecessor.
“It is not complicated, it is just a matter of knowing each other,” Maresca said. “I need to understand who is the ideal one for this kind of game and different kind of games. I don’t think it is just midfielders, also we are trying with defensive players to find the right solution.
“It’s part of the process. It is like a restart after 10 years with the same manager, same faces, same words, same methods. It’s not easy to change all of a sudden.”
Cherki is capable of amazing things, while Phil Foden infrequently threatens to rediscover his best form. De Bruyne, however, was part of a team that dominated. Often alongside Rodri and Ilkay Gündogan, the trio were almost the perfect balance of defensive diligence and attacking expertise, leaving opponents facing an nigh-on impossible task.
It is likely Maresca will change things for Napoli’s visit, with the ambition of a fourth win from five games in the Champions League , as City seek to secure progression as early as possible. Whichever team is put out, it will not have a talent like De Bruyne, meaning Maresca will have to work even harder to return to City’s Belgian-inspired peak.

Ancak turuncu-siyahlılar, rakibiyle 1-1 berabere kalarak ligde kritik bir puan kaybı yaşadı.
POLONYA SINIRINDA KRİZ ÇIKTI: 8 OYUNCUNUN GEÇİŞİNE İZİN VERİLMEDİ
Lig karşılaşmasının ardından Londra'ya gitmek üzere hazırlıklarını tamamlayan Shakhtar Donetsk kafilesi, Ukrayna'nın Lviv kentinden Polonya'ya hareket etti. Yaklaşık üç saat süren bekleyişin ardından Arda Turan ve teknik ekibin sınırdan geçişine izin verildi. Türk teknik adam ve yardımcıları, planlanan şekilde Londra'ya ulaştı. Kafilenin farklı zamanlarda Londra'ya ulaşması nedeniyle Arda Turan'ın Fenerbahçe karşılaşması öncesinde hazırladığı antrenman programında değişikliğe gidildiği öğrenildi.
Shakhtar Donetsk'te Fenerbahçe karşılaşması öncesinde sakatlıklar da Arda Turan'ın canını sıkıyor. Ukrayna temsilcisinin hücum hattındaki en önemli isimlerinden Kaua Elias, ayak tarak kemiğinin kırılması nedeniyle ameliyat olmuştu. Brezilyalı golcünün yanı sıra savunma oyuncusu Marlon ve kanat oyuncusu Pedrinho da sarı-lacivertliler karşısında forma giyemeyecek.

It was a record-breaking occasion in more ways than one. David Moyes made history for Everton, edging clear of Harry Catterick by overseeing his 593rd game in charge of the club, but calamitous defending ruined the Scot’s evening and defeat to Brentford was inevitable after James Tarkowski received his first red card in 351 Premier League appearances.
Those in Tarkowski’s corner will claim the Everton captain’s tackle on Yehor Yarmoliuk would not have been a foul back in the day. This, though, was not a “game’s gone” moment. Not that sort of player? The reality is Tarkowski’s back catalogue features plenty of orange card tackles, meaning there was always likely to come a time when his luck ran out.
Everton, whose passive performance denied them the chance to go fifth, should not bother complaining about Matthew Donohue’s intervention from Stockley Park after Tarkowski went in on Yarmoliuk with his studs raised late in the first half. It was the defender’s first red since he was playing for Brentford in the Championship and it had no great bearing on the result. Brentford led 2-0 before their former player went off, Keane Lewis-Potter’s third and fourth goals of the season putting them in control, and dominated from start to finish.
Keith Andrews, a young coach who will have done something right if he comes close to matching Moyes’s longevity, revelled in his side moving sixth thanks to an outstanding display. Moyes has been around long enough to know the top flight has rarely been this open but on this evidence Brentford look likelier than Everton to upset the established order.
It was a drubbing, a cracking third from Vitaly Janelt followed by Fábio Carvalho making it 4-0 in added time, and made clear that Brentford have the tools to challenge for European qualification.
With Igor Thiago unavailable after his controversial red card against Brighton it fell to Callum Wilson to lead the line for Brentford. Everton were unsettled by Wilson’s movement and were strangely muted. They sat in a low block but were not compact, were careless in possession and did not deal with Brentford’s wing play and midfield interchanges.
Jaidon Anthony, Mikkel Damsgaard and Michael Kayode had chances before Everton cracked. They were caught out by a long ball down the left and were undone when a poor clearing header led to a moment of brilliance from Anthony, the winger’s cushioned touch with the outside of his right foot running for Lewis-Potter to beat Jordan Pickford thanks to a deflection off Jarrad Branthwaite.
Brentford love to make the most of Lewis-Potter’s attacking instincts after converting him into a left-back. He joined as a winger and his runs are always a threat but Everton did not pay close enough attention. They were abysmal in the first half and faced more pressure when Vitaliy Mykolenko conceded a free-kick after losing Dango Ouattara. Damsgaard crossed, Everton were all at sea and Lewis-Potter scored via another deflection, this time off Thierno Barry.
Everton were dour. They sought a lifeline through Harrison Armstrong, Caoimhín Kelleher tipping the midfielder’s shot over, but composure eluded them. Tarkowski, seemingly rattled by the barracking from the home crowd, was off after storming into a challenge on Yarmoliuk. The initial call was a yellow but Tarkowski’s boot was high, the follow-through looked cynical and the force was excessive, convincing Craig Pawson to show a red after a VAR review.
“I don’t think you can tackle like that in this day and age,” Andrews said. Moyes was honest, admitting that Tarkowski’s boot was high. “I can see why the decision went against us,” Everton’s manager said.
Everton adjusted after going down to 10, Merlin Röhl going to right-back, and Barry’s header drew a superb save from Kelleher just before half-time. Brentford had to switch on. They were intense at the start of the second half and Ouattara nodded wide from Damsgaard’s cross.
Moyes had introduced Jack Grealish for Tyrique George. Yet Brentford recognised the threat and killed Everton off when Janelt used his left foot to belt a formidable shot past Pickford from 30 yards.
“We didn’t play well,” Moyes said. “It was really not like us. I’ve got no complaints with the players. They’ve done a brilliant job until now. Tonight’s performance was not excusable.”
Everton were outplayed on every metric. They were lucky Brentford waited so long to score a fourth, Carvalho coming on to round off the humiliation by bundling in a corner from close range.

Report and free match highlights from the Premier League clash between Brentford and Everton at the Gtech Community Stadium on Monday night; Keane Lewis-Potter scores twice and James Tarkowski sent off as Bees beat Toffees.
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Keane Lewis-Potter’s first-half double set Brentford on their way to a comprehensive 4-0 Premier League win over 10-man Everton.
For David Moyes it was a record-setting night to forget. His 593rd game in charge of Everton, more than any other Toffees manager, ended in misery, as James Tarkowski's red card at 2-0 down left them with no hope of a comeback at the Gtech Community Stadium on Monday night.
Vitaly Janelt added a third for Brentford, while Fabio Carvalho came off the bench to score a fourth, as they moved up to sixth in the table, a point above Everton who slipped to ninth.
It was a deserved breakthrough for Brentford midway through the first half. A lovely touch from Jaidon Anthony teed up Lewis-Potter, who saw his strike deflect past Jordan Pickford.
Four minutes later it was 2-0. This time it came from a free-kick as the ball fell to Lewis-Potter. His first effort was blocked, but he got a second bite at it, and again a deflection from his strike took the ball away from the Everton goalkeeper.
It got worse for the Toffees before the break, too. Tarkowski was first given a yellow card for his follow-through challenge on Yehor Yarmolyuk, before a VAR check saw the referee upgrade it to red.
Moyes introduced Jack Grealish at the start of the second half, his first appearance since being dropped from the squad last month, but it would make minimal difference.
Janelt's rocket on 67 minutes added a Brentford third, as he picked out the top corner from 25 yards, while substitute Carvalho prodded in from a corner in stoppage time to add the icing to the cake.

Prior to Monday night, the defender had received 74 yellow cards in the Premier League but had never been sent off - a top-flight record.
But that run came to an end at Brentford as he was given his first red card in his 351st Premier League appearance, although the decision has attracted plenty of debate.
His dismissal crucially means he will miss Sunday's Merseyside derby against Liverpool and also ruined David Moyes' record-breaking night as he took charge of his 593rd game as Everton boss - more than anyone else in the club's history.
The 4-0 loss was also the heaviest defeat Everton have had since Moyes returned to the club at the start of last year.
Tarkowski's dismissal proved a big talking point during and after the match, with opinions split on whether he should have gone. Even Moyes wasn't sure.
He told BBC Match of the Day: "My thoughts at the time, I didn't think it was but when I've looked at it again I think his foot is high. Is there enough force for it to be a red card? Not sure about that."
Just 15 minutes after Keane Lewis-Potter scored his second deflected strike of the evening, Everton skipper Tarkowski thundered into a challenge on Brentford 's Yehor Yarmoliuk.
He won the ball but also followed through with the challenge forcefully. Initially, referee Craig Pawson deemed a foul and a yellow card was enough.
But, after an intervention from the video assistant referee (VAR) and studying the replay, Pawson changed the yellow for a red.
The Premier League match centre said on X: "After VAR review, the referee overturned the original decision of yellow card for Tarkowski for the challenge on Yarmoliuk and issued a red card for serious foul play.
"VAR: 'Point of contact is on the shin. He's got speed and intensity. Studs are high.'
"REF: 'After review, Everton No.6 commits a challenge that endangers his opponent's safety, making contact with the studs onto the shin. Cancelling the yellow card - and a red card.'"
Referees are asked to take into account several considerations for what counts as serious foul play including the speed of the challenge, its intensity, force and what degree of control there was.
But, as always, there was plenty of debate about whether it was the correct decision.
BBC Sport's football issues correspondent Dale Johnson, said: "Really not sure about this as a VAR red card.
"Yes, Tarkowski absolutely ticks the boxes for speed and intensity and leading high with studs showing.
"But the question marks are that Tarkowski made only small contact and didn't have a straight leg when he did so.
"Maybe his reputation played a part? Remember, he wrongly escaped a VAR red card against Liverpool for a challenge, which was along the same lines. He won the ball and then followed through into Alexis Mac Allister. Thought that was a far stronger challenge."
BBC Radio 5 Live's - and former Blackburn Rovers striker - Chris Sutton, said on X: "Come on that's not a red… the game's gone."
Former Arsenal striker Alan Smith agreed the decision was harsh. He told Sky Sports: "Ten years ago we wouldn't have looked at it once and now we still [frame] it on the follow-through. I just can't see it.
"Only Tarkowski knows if he wanted to leave it high or if it was natural. The follow-through was just natural momentum.
"There's a bit of anger in there from Tarkowski and it's a little high but only he knows if he wanted to leave a little more on Yarmoliuk there."
Opinion was far from unanimous though, with both pundits in the Sky Sports studio adamant it was a clear red.
Former Liverpool centre-back Jamie Carragher said: "It's a red card. Tarkowski has got previous for tackles like that. He is a 90s defender, he tackles like that.
"He follows through with such force, it is excessive. You want to give him the benefit of the doubt but it's a red card."
He added: "You could argue was it a big enough mistake for VAR to get involved but I think we are splitting hairs. He doesn't need to do this."
While ex- Tottenham defender Toby Alderweireld added: "It's a red card, he knows what he is doing. 100%."
Josh, Sheffield: Never a red for Tarkowski and I'm a Liverpool fan. What's he meant to do? Stop momentum. It's a good tackle and the player runs into the natural follow through
Robin, Essex: Another game ruined by VAR! Not straight leg tackle you can surely see he turned his foot around. Poor!
Rob, Manchester: These sorts of VAR decisions are making me turn off football. Why pay all that money to watch arbitrary decisions impact the game?
Lee: It is a sad day when a good tackle gets a player sent off. You slow anything down and dissect it you can find wrongs. Yellow was a bit much and the red ridiculous, we need ex players in the VAR decisions too.
Max, Oldham: What a load of nonsense the red card is. Tarkowski can't stop his momentum. VAR has ruined another game, plus what is the ref doing? He had a chance to stick with the yellow card. Another case of an official who has never played the game.
Paul, St Asaph : Tarkowski has got away with that same foul a few times. Do think he's the type of player to leave one in on purpose.
Anon: Yes it's a red - Tarkowski knows what he's doing, it's frustration and wanting to leave a bit on the player.
Chris, Chelmsford: He does it all the time at the borderline but about time he got one.
Woody, London: Lack of refinement masked as passion, classic Tarkowski tackle there… glad to see him off.
George, Birmingham: Studs up in a tackle, he has to go. A clear red card for me.

Maximising the societal impact of the tournament, especially combating misogyny, should be a top priority
The announcement that the 2035 Women’s World Cup will be hosted in England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland has finally come and, if we aim high enough, it could have a massive societal impact.
Confirmation was a foregone conclusion – the UK was the only bidder – but that did not mean the submission was complacent or lacked ambition.
This tournament, which will be the largest single-sport event staged in the UK, has the potential to transform women’s football in the four host nations and leave a positive wider imprint.
Andy Burnham said as much in his statement after the announcement, saying it “will reach into communities across the country, bring more people into the game and leave a legacy that lasts long after the final whistle”.
In a world where the manosphere is having an increasingly negative and misogynistic influence on young boys and men, the potential impact of a Women’s World Cup on home soil cannot be underestimated.
It is a large-scale problem. A Guardian article in March highlighted that almost a third of Gen Z men and boys think a wife should obey her husband. A 2025 Movember report found that 63% of young men watch masculinity influencers. In September 2023, a YouGov report found that one in six boys aged six to 15 had a positive opinion of Andrew Tate.
The task for the next eight and a half years, and beyond the tournament, is to ensure the 2035 Women’s World Cup isn’t just a great elite football event but that its impact far beyond is maximised.
“So many people in our country are so connected to football,” said Sue Day, the Football Association’s director of women’s football. “I think we can show the country what women and girls can do and it can almost change the narrative a little bit around gender equality.
“It really can have an impact to the benefit of everyone – boys and men as well as women and girls – because there’s so much in that manosphere space that really doesn’t benefit men and boys just as much as it really doesn’t benefit women and girls.
“On the broadest level, my hope, my aspiration and my belief is that something like this touches the lives of everyone in the country. It shows everyone in the country a different way of doing gender roles.”
It is impossible to predict what scale of change the 2035 Women’s World Cup could inspire, but the scope of the bid reflects lessons learned after England hosted the 2022 Women’s Euros . Then, there was a feeling the FA underestimated the level of growth the women’s game would experience between the bid and the tournament.
Old Trafford was a late addition as host of the opening match , a response to increased interest as the tournament moved nearer. The decision to include four stadiums with capacities of less than 20,000, including Manchester City’s 4,400-seat Academy Stadium and the 7,800-seat Leigh Sports Village, was widely criticised. Of 10 host stadiums in 2022, only Wembley and Old Trafford held more than 33,000.
For the 2035 World Cup, 15 of the 22 stadiums in the bid have a capacity of more than 33,000, and 12 exceed 50,000. The list will be trimmed to about 16, but the decision to have stadiums with much bigger capacities to choose from reflects the need to avoid underestimating where the game will be then and the massively increased interest clubs and councils have in hosting the showpiece women’s tournament. It is also a recognition of the financial and commercial benefits the tournament should bring.
The gravitas of the stadium profiles adds to the broader societal impact this World Cup can have: put it in your biggest and best stadiums, have clubs show they believe in the value of women’s football, and fans will do the same.
It is hard to measure the impact the 2022 Euros in England, and the Lionesses’ historic win, had on views of women’s football in the country or the extent to which that tournament challenged misogynistic ideas and attitudes about women and their place in society. There are things that hint towards a shift in consciousness in both instances, though.
In 2022 it wasn’t until the tournament began that it caught the attention of the wider public. In many respects the buildup flew a little under the radar. By the time England’s defence of their title came around in 2025, it felt as if the wider public were invested in the tournament far earlier, knew the players, and were ready to engage.
Before 2035 there are two Women’s World Cups – next summer’s in Brazil and the 2031 tournament in the US, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica – and the UK nations have a chance to qualify for two Euros. That is a lot of top tournament football to inspire growth and fandom and for the 2035 organisers to build on.
“It will be the most amazing tournament,” Day said, “but it’s also a catalyst for growth and inspiration and something to springboard from. I think we can change the world a little bit with the tournament and we should aim that high. Why wouldn’t we aim that high?”

Caroline Weir says it is "amazing" that Scotland will host the World Cup finals
Scotland captain Caroline Weir says hosting the 2035 Women's World Cup along with England, Northern Ireland and Wales will usher in "an amazing decade of excitement" for the game in her homeland.
World governing body Fifa confirmed on Monday that the United Kingdom will host a football World Cup for the first time since England won the men's tournament on home soil in 1966.
Scotland's national stadium at Hampden Park in Glasgow and Hibernian's Easter Road Stadium in Leith are among 19 venues chosen for the 39-day competition involving 48 teams.
At the age of 31 now, Weir would have to show unusual longevity to still be playing at that point, but she still considers it "amazing news, not just for young players that hope to play there but for us, in this period in between, to develop the women's game in Scotland - and to push it.
"So I think it's amazing news and I think it's going to be an amazing decade of excitement leading into this World Cup".
Andreatta's masterplan to shock Sweden & take Scots to World Cup
The Lyon midfielder has already played for Scotland the only time they have so far qualified for a World Cup finals - in 2019.
"As a young, aspiring footballer watching football on TV growing up, for your home country to actually host a tournament itself, and the World Cup itself, the biggest tournament in football, is the most amazing thing," Weir said.
"So, if I was a 10 or 11 year old girl now, I would be thinking this is the best news ever and I'm going to work and practice and hope that, one day, I am representing Scotland in a home nations tournament playing at Hampden Park in a World Cup for Scotland.
Angie Hind, Scotland Under-23 head coach and Scottish FA player pathway manager, also thinks it will prove inspirational to the young players under her charge.
"If you think of the young players who are involved in our pathway right now, from 13 years old right through the 23s that I take, that's the future," the former Scotland midfielder told BBC Scotland.
"That's very much those players who will be pulling on a Scotland jersey when we are part of that World Cup."
Hind pointed out that it "fits perfectly" with Project 2035, announced this month by SFA and Scottish government, designed to boost the long-term growth of the girls and women's game.
For SFA head of women's and girls football Shirley Martin, it is a "tremendous milestone" considering holding a World Cup had been such "a game changer" for previous hosts.
"Ten years ago, a home World Cup have felt like a dream and now it's happening," she told BBC Radio 5 live. "I think it shows how far women's football has come."
Martin pointed out that the SFA hopes to "double our participation over that time" as well as improving coaching, referees, clubs and facilities - and are already doing so.
However, she admitted: "The one thing we need to do is increase the crowds that come to matches."

Freddie Potts has started all of Club Brugge's Champions League games
When Liverpool visit Club Brugge on Wednesday they are likely to come up against English midfielder Freddie Potts.
The 23-year-old ended a 16-year association with West Ham in the summer to join the Belgian champions for an undisclosed fee.
And he has started every game, bar one missed through suspension, in all competitions.
After losing to Aston Villa in the Champions League, they have defeated Inter Milan, Lens and PSV.
"It really is a dream because you hear the music and then you see your family in the stands and you remember all the times that you watched Champions League on TV," Potts told BBC Radio 5 Live's Euro Leagues Show.
"You think of all the memories that you make watching it and to be playing in it now is something that every kid dreams of."
Potts' whole life had been based around West Ham. He had been with the club since the age of six and his father Steve, who made 506 appearances for the Hammers, is a first-team coach.
Potts Jr played 28 times for West Ham, with 25 of them coming last season as they were relegated from the Premier League.
He also had loan spells with Wycombe in League One and Portsmouth in the Championship.
"In pre-season my minutes with West Ham were limited, they weren't as much as I wanted and then I spoke with my agent and said 'let's explore options because this season I'm 22, turning 23'," Potts said.
"It's a massive part of my career and I wanted to play. The opportunity of Club Brugge came along with Champions League football, the best club in Belgium and it was an opportunity I couldn't really turn down with how my minutes were going down with West Ham.
"I grew up in the area, going to the stadium watching the games. It was always going to be a tough decision but it was something that I had to do for my career.
"It was an emotional decision because it had to be made quite quickly. It's been the right decision for me and so far I'm enjoying it, I'm loving life here."
Club Brugge won the Belgian title last season and are second, just one point behind leaders Union Saint-Gilloise this campaign.
"It's a physical league," said Potts. "My running and physical stats have been higher than they've ever been. It's a demanding league in that way.
"Club Brugge demands a lot, from winning the ball back and going man for man in the press. And your responsibility off the ball is something that you have to take really seriously."
Freddie Potts on leaving West Ham, life in Belgium and beating Inter Milan
Potts says he has not started to learn French or Flemish and that team talks are done in English, with the side managed by Croat Ivan Leko.
"The whole move itself is funny because we used to visit Brugge when I was a kid," he said.
"We used to come around Christmas, so my family all know the city. And now I'm here they come out as much as they can.
"It's a great city with a lot of culture. It's brilliant. You won't find many places like it."
Next up for the side is the visit of Liverpool this week - with both clubs on nine points after four games.
"Everyone knows Liverpool as a club, the size and the Premier League teams," said Potts, who started for West Ham at home to the Reds last season.
"It's going to be a big game. We're level on points in the Champions League and we've put big performances in this competition and we're hoping that we're going to do the same."

Beattie won the last of her 13 caps last year while the uncapped Haughey was last called into the senior squad in 2021
Michael McArdle has decided the upcoming friendly double-header against Greece is the perfect time to bring back Kerry Beattie and Ella Haughey from the international wilderness.
Glentoran midfielder Chloe McCarron is also in under McArdle for the first time after a lengthily absence, but the Glentoran midfielder would likely have been included sooner if not for a spell on the sidelines through injury.
Beattie won her last cap a year ago while Haughey will hope to make a senior debut in one of the two games against Greece at Inver Park after she was an unused substitute in friendlies against England and Scotland in her sole call up in 2021.
The inclusion of both players, who have been in good form at their clubs, shows McArdle is willing to keep the door open for a return to the international squad if players are performing at club level.
Portsmouth striker Beattie has been in and out of squads since her debut in 2021.
The 24-year-old has four goals in 13 caps, the last of which she won against Iceland in the Nations League play-off a year ago.
A prolific forward during two spells at Glentoran, she has struggled for consistency in moves across to Scotland with the likes of Glasgow City, Hearts and Aberdeen.
She left the Dons in the summer and consulted with McArdle when deciding upon her next move, before joining WSL 2 side Portsmouth.
Beattie has eight goals in all competitions for a Pompey side languishing at the bottom of the table and McArdle is pleased she has settled in well.
"Kerry had spells at Hearts and Aberdeen and for whatever reason it didn't quite work out at both, she had good spells but not a consistent run to express herself," McArdle said.
"The move to Portsmouth, I was delighted she reached out to me for some advice, it's an alignment for her and it's been a great move on and off the pitch. It's allowed her to enjoy herself but also play 90 minutes and be that focal point striker.
"She will have been disappointed not to make the squad for the [World Cup] play-off [against Portugal] with her form but she worked hard and she's back in, I'm delighted for her."
Beattie faces stiff competition for the starting striker role from the likes of returning captain Simone Magill and Kess Elmore, who impressed in the last camp and scored against Portugal, but she should receive some minutes across the two games and will be keen to grasp her chance to make an impact.
Left-back Haughey was called up to the senior squad as a 16-year-old under Kenny Shiels, but did not feature
West Brom defender Haughey's last involvement with NI came when she represented the under-19s in 2023.
A Lisburn Rangers player when Kenny Shiels included her in the senior squad as a 16-year-old, Haughey then moved to Nottingham Forest before settling at the Baggies, who play in the National League.
The left-back, 22, has been a regular this season for the club in the third tier and combines playing with her university studies.
Left-back has been a problem position for NI which McArdle has been trying to address as demonstrated by him bringing in Lucy-Jayne Grant in the last camp and Haughey for this window to allow Rebecca Holloway to play as a central defender.
Haughey will be competing with Grant to fill that full-back role on the left side and McArdle believes she is more than capable of doing so having tried to bring her back into the squad earlier in his reign.
"Ella's been at West Brom for a few years now. She has real potential, strong, athletic potential. We tried to call her up sooner but there were some challenges," he explained.
"She's probably been one of their top performers and one of the top performers in the league. Delighted she's earned this opportunity and hopefully she can make her debut and achieve her first cap."
McArdle has made a concerted to continue to widen the player pool available to him as he aims to build depth ahead of the Nations League campaign next year, but if Beattie and Haughey catch the eye it will show that giving chances to those previously involved under different managers could be another possibility.

Youngest player to appear in Premier League is struggling to establish himself on loan at the Bundesliga club
E than Nwaneri has one record Max Dowman can never break. It is more than four years since he became the youngest player to appear in the Premier League , with Dowman, his fellow Hale End academy graduate, older by 54 days when he made his highly anticipated debut . But after a week when Arsenal published an article dedicated to Dowman’s growing collection of milestones, Nwaneri risks becoming the club’s forgotten teenager.
Nwaneri joined Borussia Dortmund on loan in the summer and returns to the Emirates Stadium in the Champions League on Tuesday, although the 19-year-old will probably be on the bench, having not started for the German club yet in the competition. Despite making a good impression with an assist on his Bundesliga debut, against Hoffenheim, he has not started in the league since 17 October and has yet to complete more than 65 minutes in a Bundesliga match.
He was a stoppage-time substitute in Saturday’s win against Borussia Mönchengladbach, with Dortmund’s manager, Niko Kovac, saying Nwaneri faces a fight to get back in a team who lead Bayern Munich by two points and deploy the exciting Greece teenager Kosta Karetsas as one of two No 10s.
“We have some very good players in those attacking positions,” Kovac said before the Gladbach game. “The competition is fierce. He [Nwaneri] has played a lot of games and, at just 19 years of age, he will certainly play many more games for us.”
Nwaneri established that Premier League record in September 2022, at 15 years and 181 days old, but his real breakthrough came in the 2024-25 campaign as a replacement for the injured Bukayo Saka on the right. He scored eight goals, matching records set by Wayne Rooney and Michael Owen, and was even compared with Barcelona’s Lamine Yamal, who was also born in 2007.
Nwaneri was rewarded with a new long-term contract despite strong interest from Chelsea and Dortmund, who have a record of signing emerging English talent . Heavy investment by Arsenal that summer, including Eberechi Eze and Noni Madueke , meant he barely featured in the first half of last season and was allowed to join Marseille in January.
Arsenal chose the French club from a long list of suitors because they wanted him to develop under Roberto De Zerbi. Nwaneri scored on debut, but De Zerbi left by mutual consent a few weeks later and the attacking midfielder barely featured towards the end of the season.
The emergence of Dowman, who, as a 14-year-old, in December 2024, broke Nwaneri’s record as the youngest player to appear for Arsenal Under-21s, means he has slipped further down the pecking order. Mikel Arteta is understood to be keen for Nwaneri to develop as a No 10 rather than a winger and loaned him again despite not signing attacking reinforcements in the summer after the departures of Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus. Arsenal’s manager said on Monday he had been disappointed by Nwaneri’s fortunes in Germany.
“Because you go there and because you come from Arsenal, it doesn’t give you any advantage, so you need to earn it,” he said. “You can have patches, but to find that consistency and to play a big amount of minutes and have a huge impact in such big football clubs like Arsenal or Dortmund, it’s extremely difficult. That’s the reality.
“You can just shine in moments, but moments are not enough. Now you need to show the consistency. Ethan has the capacity and the mentality to do that and it takes some time.”
While Nwaneri’s Arsenal career has stalled, he has seen his childhood friend Myles Lewis-Skelly begin to establish himself in his preferred central midfield role for club and country. The England Under-21s manager, Lee Carsley, remains a big fan, though, and Nwaneri repaid that faith by setting up the first two goals in a 3-2 win against France last week , even if Dowman took the headlines again by breaking Jude Bellingham’s record as their youngest goalscorer with a late winner.
Nwaneri, whose brother Emerson plays for ArsenalUnder-18s, was one of four training players called up for England’s World Cup preparation camp in Florida, with Rio Ngumoha, Josh King and Alex Scott, and remains on Thomas Tuchel’s radar. But as Arteta, who was sent on loan from Barcelona to Paris Saint-Germain at the start of his career, acknowledged when asked whether Arsenal may consider a January recall that it is up to Nwaneri to rediscover his best form at Dortmund.
“He was in Marseille as well. Marseille had a completely different context for a lot of things that I saw and expected to happen. But that builds a player, that builds the character and the career of a player. I’m so convinced of that.”
For Arteta, there is only one meaningful way for Nwaneri to deal with the frustration of his role as a substitute. “Try to change it for the one that you want,” he said. “That’s football.”

Sarı-lacivertliler, Avrupa kupalarında geride kalan 310 müsabakada 123 galibiyet elde ederken 69 beraberlik aldı. Sahadan 118 kez mağlup ayrılan Fenerbahçe, bu maçlarda rakip fileleri 423 kez havalandırdı, kalesinde 437 gol gördü.
Fenerbahçe, Avrupa futbolunun 1 numaralı organizasyonunda yarın 45. müsabakasını oynayacak.
Sarı-lacivertliler, UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi'ndeki 44 karşılaşmada 12 galibiyet elde ederken 8 beraberlik, 24 yenilgi yaşadı.
Fenerbahçe, rakip filelere 48 gol atarken kalesinde 81 gole engel olamadı. Sarı-lacivertli ekip, bu kulvardaki son mücadelesinde sahasında İngiliz ekibi Liverpool'u 3-2 yenmeyi başardı.
UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi'ne ilk kez 1996-1997 sezonunda katılan Fenerbahçe, daha sonra sırasıyla 2001-2002, 2004-2005, 2005-2006, 2007-2008 ve 2008-2009 sezonlarında grup aşamasında ter döktü.
İstanbul ekibi, bu sezondan önce 6 kez katıldığı UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde en büyük başarısını çeyrek final oynayarak gerçekleştirdi.
Sarı-lacivertliler, 2007-2008 sezonunda Brezilyalı teknik direktör Arthur Zico yönetiminde yarı finalin kapısından dönerken Avrupa kupaları tarihindeki en başarılı sezonunu yaşadı.
Avrupa'nın kulüpler düzeyindeki en büyük futbol organizasyonuna bu sezon elemelerden katılan Fenerbahçe, toplamda 7. kez, 36 takımlı lig aşamasında ise ilk mücadelesini veriyor.
Fenerbahçe'nin UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi'ndeki performans tablosu şöyle:
Ukrayna takımlarıyla daha önce 12 kez rakip olan Fenerbahçe, bu karşılaşmalarda 3 galibiyet elde ederken 5 müsabakadan beraberlikle ayrıldı. Sarı-lacivertliler 4 maçta ise rakiplerine kaybetti.
Ukranya'nın Shakhtar Donetsk takımıyla 2015-16 sezonunda UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi Elemeleri'nde rakip olan Fenerbahçe, rakibiyle sahasında 0-0 berabere kalırken deplasmanda 3-0 yenilerek turu geçemedi.
Fenerbahçe, Ukrayna ekipleriyle bugüne dek 12 kez karşı karşıya gelirken bu maçların 8'inde Dinamo Kiev ile rakip oldu.
2 maçta Shakhtar, 2 maçta da Zorya'yla karşı karşıya gelen sarı-lacivertliler. 8 müsabakada da Dinamo Kiev'in karşısına çıktı.
Ukrayna ekibi Shakhtar Donetsk, Tük takımlarıyla bugüne dek 10 kez karşı karşıya gelirken bu maçlarda yenilgi yaşamadı.
Sivasspor, Fenerbahçe, Başakşehir, Konyaspor ve Beşiktaş ile toplamda 10 maçta karşı karşıya gelen Shakhtar Donetsk, bu müsabakalarda 9 galibiyet elde ederken 1 maçta da sahadan beraberlikle ayrıldı.
Ukrayna ekibi bu maçlarda 21 gol kaydederken kalesinde 3 gol gördü.

Fenerbahçe, UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi'nin beşinci haftasında yarın Ukrayna'nın Shakhtar Donetsk ekibiyle İngiltere'de karşı karşıya gelecek.
Londra'da Chelsea'nin maçlarını oynadığı Stamford Bridge'deki müsabaka, TSİ 23.00'te başlayacak.
İngiltere Futbol Federasyonundan Michael Oliver'ın yöneteceği 90 dakikada Stuart Burt ve James Mainwaring, yardımcı hakem görevi yapacak.
UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde geride kalan 4 maçta 1 galibiyet, 2 beraberlik ve 1 yenilgi yaşayan sarı-lacivertli ekip, 5 puanla 19. sırada yer alıyor.
İngiliz ekibi Liverpool'u ligdeki son maçında konuk eden Fenerbahçe, 2 kez geriye düştüğü karşılaşmadan 3-2'lik galibiyetle ayrılmayı başardı.
Savaş sebebiyle maçlarını Ukrayna'da oynayamayan Arda Turan'ın çalıştırdığı Shakhtar Donetsk ise ligde 4 maçta 4 puan toplamayı başardı. Ukrayna temsilcisi, 21. sırada yer alıyor.
Fenerbahçe'de Shakhtar Donetsk maçı öncesinde 2 eksik isim bulunuyor.
Sakatlıkları devam eden Nathan Ake ve Marco Asensio, yarın oynanacak müsabakada takımlarını yalnız bırakacak.
Fenerbahçe ile Shakhtar Donetsk, resmi olarak ilk kez 2015-2016 sezonunda Şampiyonlar Ligi elemelerinde rakip oldu. Organizasyonun 3. turu ilk maçında taraflar Kadıköy'de golsüz berabere kalırken, rövanşta Ukrayna ekibi 3-0'lık skorla tur atladı.
Fenerbahçe, 19 Nisan 2022'de barış temasına dikkat çekmek ve katkı sağlamak amacıyla Shakhtar Donetsk ile dostluk maçı yaptı. Kadıköy'de 'Barış için futbol' temasıyla oynanan bu karşılaşmanın geliri, savaş mağduru masum insanlar ve çocuklar için kullanıldı. Karşılaşmanın tek golünü Enner Valencia kaydetti.
Fenerbahçe, Avrupa kupalarında yarın oynayacağı mücadeleyle birlikte 311. maçına çıkacak. Sarı-lacivertliler, bu süreçte 123 galibiyet alırken, 69 beraberlik, 118 de yenilgi yaşadı. Kanarya, rakip filelere 423 gol gönderirken, kalesinde ise 437 gol gördü.
Sarı-lacivertliler, UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde 44 maç oynadı. Kanarya, bu karşılaşmalarda 12 galibiyet, 24 mağlubiyet ve 8 beraberlik elde etti. Bu süreçte ağları 48 kez sarsan Fenerbahçe, 81 gole engel olamadı.
Fenerbahçe, bugüne kadar Ukrayna temsilcileri ile 12 kez kozlarını paylaştı. Sarı-lacivertliler en fazla 8 kez ile Dinamo Kiev'e rakip oldu. Fenerbahçe, Şampiyonlar Ligi elemeleri, grup aşaması ve Avrupa Ligi'nde eşleştiği rakibine karşı 2 galibiyet, 3 beraberlik, 3 mağlubiyet yaşadı. Kanarya, Zorya Luhansk ile de 2 maç yaparken, bu maçlarda 1 galibiyet, 1 beraberlik aldı.
Shakhtar Donetsk, güvenlik nedeniyle Şampiyonlar Ligi maçlarını Stamford Bridge'de oynuyor. Fenerbahçe de 18 yıl sonra bu sahada maça çıkacak. Sarı-lacivertliler, 8 Nisan 2008'de Şampiyonlar Ligi çeyrek final rövanş maçında Chelsea ile karşılaşmış ve sahadan 2-0 mağlup ayrılarak Devler Ligi'ne veda etmişti.
Ukrayna ekibinde Türk teknik direktör Arda Turan görev yapıyor. Turuncu-siyahlı takımda ikinci sezonunu yaşayan 39 yaşındaki teknik adam, ilk sezonunda lig şampiyonluğu yaşadı. Aynı zamanda UEFA Konferans Ligi'nde de takımını yarı final oynatma başarısı gösteren Arda Turan, bu sezon da Devler Ligi'nde mücadele ediyor.
İki ekip arasındaki müsabaka aynı zamanda iki yakın dostun da mücadelesi olacak. Futbolculuk kariyerlerinde Fenerbahçe - Galatasaray derbilerinde rakip olan Emre Belözoğlu ile Arda Turan, 2012 yılında da Atletico Madrid'de birlikte forma giydi. A Milli Takım'da 100'ün üzerinde maça çıkan Belözoğlu ile Turan, teknik adam olarak ilk kez 25 Mayıs 2025'te Eyüpspor - Antalyaspor maçında karşılaştı. İkili bu kez Devler Ligi'nde takımlarının başarısı için kenarda olacak.
Yarınki mücadele aynı zamanda 'Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde iki Türk teknik direktörün karşılaştığı ilk maç' olarak kayıtlara geçecek.
Arda Turan'ın öğrencileri Ukrayna Ligi'nde 13 maç yaptı. Ligde 9 galibiyet, 3 beraberlik ve 1 mağlubiyet alan Shakhtar, 30 puanla liderlik koltuğunda oturuyor. 23 gol atan turuncu-siyahlılar, 6 gole engel olamadı. Shakhtar Donetsek, son maçında Livyi Bereh ile 1-1 berabere kaldı.
Shakhtar Donetsk, Avrupa kupalarında bu zamana kadar Türk takımlarıyla 10 maça çıktı. Ukrayna temsilcisi Fenerbahçe dışında Beşiktaş, Konyaspor, Başakşehir ve Sivasspor ile karşı karşıya gelirken, bu maçlarda 9 galibiyet, 1 beraberlik elde etti ve mağlubiyet yaşamadı.
Fenerbahçe'nin İngiliz oyuncusu Mason Greenwood, son 3 maçta 4 kez gol sevinci yaşarken, Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde oynanan son 2 maçta da fileleri havalandırdı. Süper Lig'de 7 golü bulunan Greenwood, tüm kulvarlarda kaydettiği 11 golle takımının en golcü oyuncusu olarak ön plana çıkıyor.

İngiltere'nin başkenti Londra'da bulunan Stamford Bridge'de oynanacak mücadeleyle Emre Belözoğlu, sarı-lacivertli kulübün tarihine geçecek.
Futbolculuk kariyerinde Fenerbahçe formasıyla 227 karşılaşmada görev yapan Emre Belözoğlu, 2008-2009 sezonunda sarı-lacivertli ekiple UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde 3 maça çıktı.
Gruplarda oynanan 2 Porto mücadelesinde ve 1 Dinamo Kiev maçında forma giyen Belözoğlu, teknik direktörlük kariyerindeki ilk Şampiyonlar Ligi müsabakasına yarın çıkacak.

Kitap dünyasına açılan kapınızı aralayın! En sevdiğiniz kitapları indirimli fiyatlarla keşfedin ve hayal gücünüzü genişletin.
NBA'de Houston Rockets , milli oyuncu Alperen Şengün 'ün 20 sayı, 8 ribaunt, 7 asistlik performans sergilediği maçta sahasında Los Angeles Clippers 'ı 116-104 yendi.
Houston'daki karşılaşmada Alperen Şengün'ün 20 sayı, 8 ribaunt, 7 asist ve 2 blokla katkı verdiği Rockets, Clippers'ı 12 sayı farkla mağlup etti.
Rockets'ta Kevin Durant, 32 sayıyla kendisi adına sezonun en yüksek sayısını kaydederek maçın da en skorer oyuncusu oldu.
Üst üste 4. maçını kaybeden Clippers'ta Darius Garland'ın 26 sayısı mağlubiyeti engellemeye yetmedi.
Portland Trail Blazers, deplasmanda Philadelphia 76ers'ı 128-111 mağlup ederek rakibinin 5 maçlık galibiyet serisini sona erdirdi.
Blazers'ta Deni Avdija, 31 sayı kaydederek galibiyete katkı verdi. Portland adına Donovan Clingan 15 sayı ve 18 ribaunt kaydederken Damian Lillard ve Jrue Holiday ise 18'er sayı attı.
LeBron James'in 23, Tyrese Maxey'nin 22 sayı attığı 76ers'ta sakatlığını atlatan milli oyuncu Adem Bona, parkelere geri dönerken 5 dakika 23 saniye süre alarak 4 sayı, 2 ribaunt, 1 top çalma ve 1 blok kaydetti.

After Manchester United's 4-0 thrashing at Liverpool, Mauricio Pochettino's side officially have the worst defence in Europe and have endured their worst start to a season in over half a century - so are they going down?
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
What started as a blip has become a problem far more systemic for Man Utd.
"If the name wasn't Man Utd and you're watching their performances, you'd say they are a team in a relegation fight. They're conceding lots of goals, a comedy of errors, red cards - they've won one game all season," said Sky Sports' Jamie Carragher.
Only Ipswich beaten in 11 attempts, the worst defence in Europe - and a 4-0 hammering at Liverpool on Sunday to wipe the gloss off Mauricio Pochettino's arrival within 12 first-half minutes.
Carragher added: "This Manchester United back four can't cope with pace. They're a million miles off it in terms of coming up against what they are in the Premier League."
The unthinkable is beginning to become thinkable. Are United in an actual relegation battle now?
"They're in a relegation fight right now because of where they are in the table," said Carragher after a fifth defeat of the season left them with their lowest points tally at this stage of a season since 1972. "You can't say anything else when you look at their record this season.
"We don't believe it will happen over a 38-game season, but they haven't had the most difficult of starts. They've played a lot of promoted teams; they haven't played the best team in the league, Arsenal, yet.
"I don't think they'll go down, but this idea that they haven't got a scrap on their hands, they have."
It seems unfathomable. But should it? The numbers don't give Pochettino any grounds for optimism. Only 26 teams - barely one a season - have picked up eight points or fewer from their opening 11 games in the history of the Premier League and only 13 of those, exactly half, avoided the drop.
Of course, most of those were not clubs anywhere near the size and stature of Manchester United. But even the Opta supercomputer, which provides far more contextualised feedback, is losing faith and gives them a 24 per cent chance of going down - though it does still back them to stumble to safety and finish 16th.
"You wonder how low it can get," said Gary Neville after Sunday's defeat. "It's embarrassing. I don't believe they're in a relegation fight, they'll get out of this, but this is the worst Man Utd have been in 53 years. The worst defensive team in Europe, second-bottom in the league, they've never started this badly.
That may be putting it lightly. As well as the worst defence in Europe's top-five leagues across all competitions, United also have the third-worst performing attack in the Premier League, falling below their xG tally by 4.2 goals already.
In an immediately infamous tweet in 2014, then-boss David Moyes was quoted as saying United "must improve in a number of areas, including passing, creating chances and defending".
Pochettino is unlikely to admit it publicly, but behind closed doors must have similarly widespread concerns even at this early stage. United have not found themselves in the bottom two after 11 games in 40 years.
Sir Alex Ferguson was brought in as their eventual saviour that winter, but turning the tide on this United side is a significantly bigger ask.
Are there personnel at his disposal who could improve matters? Potentially. Neville did pinpoint a back four of Luke Shaw, Harry Maguire, Lisandro Martinez and Diego Dalot who could at least get United out of their defensive slump.
"It's a poor back four, but it's their best back four. It could compete," he added. "But the one that started today and finished against Villa a few weeks ago, that'll get you relegated."
There is good news and bad news. Neville's quartet are unbeaten in every game they have started together since the start of 2023/24 - and can boast a 70-per-cent win ratio. Unfortunately for Pochettino, that only amounts to 10 games across more than three seasons, owing largely to availability.
But that still does not solve the problem of their limp attack. Of the 22 players to have attempted a shot for the club this season, 19 have under-performed their xG, and the three who have not, Benjamin Sesko, Joshua Zirkzee and Youri Tielemans, have scored only a solitary goal apiece.
There remain huge question marks over the Man Utd dressing room, its commitment and a lack of leadership which permeated into the public sphere in the final weeks of Michael Carrick's reign. Though Pochettino's players have shown they can perform when they want to. Carrick himself knows that better than anyone.
But his successor barely has time to address it over the next few weeks, with only one free midweek between now and the end of 2026 - and even then he has a trip to the Emirates, live on Sky Sports on December 20, to face at the end of his first uninterrupted week on the training pitch.
By that point United will be almost half-way through the Premier League season - and alarm bells will be ringing even louder if they still find themselves in the quagmire, especially with rock bottom Crystal Palace and promoted Coventry to come before then.
"If you look at the strength of the Premier League this season, in terms of what we would call the teams you'd expect to be mid-table or near the bottom - it's probably as strong as it's ever been," said Carragher.
"There's no poor teams. There's not many great teams, but there's no poor teams.

Sezen Aksu 'nun son albümündeki "Kiraz Mevsimi", video klibiyle dinleyiciyle buluştu. Klibin başrolünde tiyatro ve sinema oyuncusu Bennu Yıldırımlar yer alıyor.
Söz ve müziği Sezen Aksu'ya, düzenlemesi Aytuğ Yargıç'a ait olan "Kiraz Mevsimi", sanatçının Nisan 2026'da yayımlanan "Biz Yeniden Başlarız" albümünde yer alıyor.
Klipteki hikaye, geçmişten kalan bir kasetin saklanmasıyla başlıyor. Bennu Yıldırımlar'ın canlandırdığı karakter, bu kasetle gençlik yıllarına ait anılarıyla yeniden karşılaşıyor.
Yıllar önce yaşanmış bir aşkın izini süren klip, hatırlamanın hüznünü, zamanın geride bıraktıklarını ve hayatın devam edişini sade ve sinematografik bir anlatımla aktarıyor.
Klibin yönetmenliğini Gizem İbak üstlendi. Yapım Porte Film'e, yapımcılık Selçuk Metin'e ait. Görüntü yönetmenliğini ise Uğur İçbak yaptı. Klipte Bennu Yıldırımlar'a Yağmur Damcıoğlu, Gürdeniz Bursalı, Albina Özden, Öykü Naz Altay ve Fatma İbak eşlik ediyor.
"Kiraz Mevsimi"nin klibi, Sezen Aksu'nun resmi YouTube kanalında ve dijital platformlarda izlenebiliyor.
